sourceAuthority: CDC/NCHS NHANES public-use DEMO_J plus public-use Linked Mortality File

sourceFindings.observedFact: DEMO_J documents WTMEC2YR as the full sample 2 year MEC exam weight with 8704 positive range values, 550 zero values marked Not MEC Examined and 0 missing values.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: A positive-weight eligible-base check must exclude zero-weight non-MEC records before any future design-based domain estimator.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS NHANES variance guidance says Taylor-linearized subpopulation variance requires all observations with a non-zero value for the weight variable and a subpopulation indicator.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: Human Infra must build the non-zero-weight design input before evaluating any domain indicator.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS warns analysts never to drop records from the analysis dataset before executing complex survey procedures for subgroup analysis.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: A post-join subgroup table or row-filtered dataframe is not an eligible-base substitute for design-based domain analysis.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The current aggregate pilot records 5809 eligible adults, 5809 positive WTMEC2YR eligible adults, 0 zero-weight eligible adults, 0 missing-weight eligible adults, 15 positive-weight strata and 0 lonely positive-weight strata, without persisting eligible-base rows.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The positive-weight eligible base is now diagnosable as aggregate metadata, but no weighted estimator, domain rate, standard error, interval or calibration output is authorized.

readinessGates.evidence: DEMO_J documents WTMEC2YR positive, zero and missing counts.
NHANES variance guidance documents non-zero weight design input plus subpopulation indicator.
Aggregate pilot now records positive/zero/missing WTMEC2YR eligible-adult counts and design-field completeness diagnostics without persisting rows.
Aggregate pilot modelUseBoundary and eligibleBaseDiagnostics keep rawRowsPersisted, individualRowsInOutput and eligibleBaseRowsPersisted false.
No R survey, Stata, SAS, SUDAAN or equivalent backend has been selected and tested for NHANES weighted domain outputs.
The eligible-base diagnostic does not yet evaluate a domain indicator inside a complex-survey design object.
No review exists for domain degrees-of-freedom, lonely PSU, empty domain or sparse-cell estimator behavior.
No disclosure review exists for future weighted domain cells, rates, intervals or subgroup summaries.
